## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C reorganization and TRA execution

- 2016-12-19: 144A private placement and Up-C restructuring; Legacy TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with SES Legacy Holdings, LLC and Crestview Partners II GP as agent
- 2017-04-28: Registered IPO under "WTTR" on NYSE
- 2017-07-18: Amendment No. 1 executed concurrent with the Rockwater merger agreement, carving the Rockwater transaction out of the Change of Control trigger

#### Routine maintenance

- 2023-06-23: Amendment No. 2 transitions LIBOR references to CME Term SOFR plus 71.513 basis points pursuant to the LIBOR Act; no change to economic terms

## Explanation

Select Energy Services, Inc. (renamed Select Water Solutions, Inc. in 2023) executed two parallel Tax Receivable Agreements on December 19, 2016 at its 144A Up-C reorganization, each at 85% of net cash tax savings covering Section 754 basis step-ups, net operating losses, and imputed interest. The Legacy TRA covers the SES Legacy Holdings beneficiary side; the parallel Non-Blocker TRA covers the Crestview-affiliated Non-Blocker Holders. Both TRAs were amended in July 2017 to exempt the Rockwater merger from the Change of Control trigger and again in June 2023 for the LIBOR-to-SOFR benchmark transition. Both remain in force as of the FY2025 10-K; combined recorded TRA liability is $43.4M at year-end 2025 with only $0.6M of cumulative payments through 2025, the first material payment ($0.5M) occurring in 2024. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the parallel Non-Blocker TRA.
